subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Is an unconditional 8 MiB maximum the supported compatibility contract for existing `openclaw config set --batch-file` users, or should the limit and failure behavior be adjusted before merge?
rationale: The implementation safely bounds memory, but source and provided discussion do not establish that valid existing configuration batches are always below 8 MiB; selecting that public CLI boundary is a maintainer product and upgrade decision.

options.title: Approve a documented 8 MiB contract
options.body: Confirm that 8 MiB is an acceptable public limit, then add exact-boundary coverage and user-facing guidance for the new rejection behavior.

options.title: Choose a compatibility-backed limit
options.body: Set the cap and diagnostics from supported batch payload expectations, preserving bounded reads without silently invalidating legitimate existing workflows.

recommendation.title: Choose a compatibility-backed limit
recommendation.body: Set the cap and diagnostics from supported batch payload expectations, preserving bounded reads without silently invalidating legitimate existing workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor connected to the analogous merged bounded-reader work and the current implementation; a repository owner should make the final public-contract decision.
